title: Research a Todo's current situation
summary: Create a dated, evidence-backed account of what is true now, who owns each area, what constraints and gaps exist, and whether the todo is ready for desired-state design.
use_when: An open canonical `tN` needs a dated evidence-grounded description of current state before design reconciliation.
Each relevant jurisdiction should identify exactly one owner plus any participants and consumers.
do_not_use_when: The request is to choose desired architecture, revise direction, authorize a decision, or execute work.
The subject is not an established open canonical todo umbrella.
Runtime or tool failure would be misrepresented as a domain evidence gap.
outcome: One immutable dated `aN` bound to exact todo and source bases, with current findings, jurisdictions, direction coverage, unresolved items, and a ready, needs-user-choice, or inconclusive disposition.
effects: Freezes current direction, concerns, note cursor, accepted design, Todo projection, and a catalog of admitted evidence sources.
Submits one constrained Nucleus job with source-specific read/search tools and may consume Codex allowance.
Records one immutable assessment; any newer assessment for the umbrella makes every older one non-current.
authority: Todo owns assessment bases, source references, findings, jurisdictions, disposition, currentness, and domain success.
The liaison can describe current state only; it cannot revise direction, choose design, route concerns, or authorize changes.
success: Todo records a complete `aN` whose material findings cite admitted exact basis references.
Every jurisdiction has concrete responsibilities and exactly one owner.
The disposition truthfully distinguishes adequate evidence, required user choice, and material evidence gaps.
failure_and_recovery: A runtime or missing-tool failure is reported as infrastructure failure rather than an inconclusive domain fact.
If direction, attachments, notes, accepted design, or source bases change, retain the historical assessment but treat it as stale and reassess.
Creating a newer assessment intentionally makes the older assessment non-current.
privacy: Todo retains source locators, frozen revisions, observation times, and evidence references rather than copying ordinary decision-source contents.
Nucleus raw output may retain source content read by the assessment liaison.
does_not_authorize: Revising the todo direction or routing concerns.
Choosing or accepting a desired design.
Implementing any identified gap or responsibility.
